QF.id: III-C Prevention of Money Laundering Act_18

question.text: Under the AML guidelines, intermediaries filing an STR are prohibited from disclosing ('tipping off') the fact to the client. This prohibition extends to which period?

answer.text: Only before and during the submission
Before, during, and after the submission of an STR

explanation.text: The Logic: The source workbook states that the prohibition on tipping off extends to filing and also to before, during, and after the submission of an STR, which is what the cited page supports. The Trap: The other options narrow the prohibition to a single phase, which appears intuitive if one assumes the duty starts only at the moment of filing or ends once the report is lodged. Note: Only the before-during-after rule is anchored to the page checked; specific operational consequences such as evidence destruction would require a separately cited source.
